portInfo.description: Cruise ships call at Getxo maritime stations in the Port of Bilbao complex. The authority publishes dedicated getting-there pages for Getxo 1&2 (with GPS 43.339182, -3.021255) and Getxo 3. Cruises overview notes year-round reception, a twenty-minute drive to city centre and airport, and a shuttle bus linking cruise passengers to public transport. Guggenheim Bilbao is the signature city attraction for longer transfers.
